S2 [极端/困难特性突出 Challenging Dataset Properties]：Notably, [Dataset A] exhibits [Hard Property 1, e.g., strong covariate shift], whereas [Dataset B] tests scalability across [Hard Property 2, e.g., 862 correlated channels].

focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 只是把数据集名字和基线名字干巴巴列了一遍，没有说明选这些数据集和基线背后的科学验证意图。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: To evaluate robustness across diverse non-stationary regimes, we conduct experiments on seven public benchmarks spanning energy grid load (ETT, ECL), meteorological telemetry (Weather), and urban traffic flow (Traffic). Notably, Weather contains abrupt atmospheric pressure transitions that test non-stationary adaptability, whereas Traffic spans 862 synchronized sensors that challenge high-dimensional scalability. We benchmark our approach against 11 state-of-the-art methods across three paradigms: channel-independent patch Transformers (PatchTST), variate-mixing architectures (iTransformer, Crossformer), and frequency-domain forecasters (TimesNet, FEDformer). All baselines are reproduced under identical lookback windows ($L=96$) and prediction horizons ($H \in \{96, 192, 336, 720\}$) using standard MSE and MAE metrics.

focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The diagram illustrates the closed-loop data curation pipeline for embodied robot learning, spanning four primary stages from teleoperated collection to failure-driven retraining. The cycle begins when raw multimodal demonstrations are recorded via VR teleoperation and filtered to discard kinematic singularities and dropped frames. Once validated, the trajectory stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: visual frames undergo background augmentation, while proprioceptive states are normalized into local gripper coordinates. These processed streams are subsequently synchronized to train the visuomotor policy, whose real-world rollout failures are logged and fed back into the teleoperation buffer to close the active-learning loop.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 局限性（Limitations）的无损诚实写法：界定适用边界而非自毁贡献
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 顶会强制要求写 Limitations。高水平写法是：明确指出当前方法在什么极端假设违背下（如极端稀疏采样、毫秒级超高速碰撞）性能会受限，并立即给出造成该边界的客观算力/物理原因及可行的下一步演进路径。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: While our framework performs robustly under [Standard Regime], its accuracy/efficiency is currently bounded when [Extreme Condition]. This limitation arises because [Objective Mechanism], suggesting a promising direction in [Concrete Future Fix].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 要么写成虚假自夸（Our only limitation is that our model is too general），要么写成致命自毁（Our model fails completely on real data）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Our model has some limitations. It is too slow when there are many variables and does not work well on irregular time series.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While our cross-variate graph module scales linearly with sequence length, its quadratic complexity with respect to channel count ($O(C^2)$) increases memory overhead when $C > 1,000$. Incorporating low-rank channel projection or sparse k-NN graph routing offers a direct path to scaling toward ultra-high-dimensional sensor arrays.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 把“慢”精确化为通道维度的 $O(C^2)$ 复杂度边界（$C > 1,000$），并顺势给出低秩投影或稀疏 k-NN 路由的建设性解法。

focal_logic_rules.category: Domain Discourse (具身智能专属论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 具身智能感知-决策-控制闭环与 Sim-to-Real 论证规范（Embodied AI Closed-Loop Logic）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Embodied Perception-Action Loop and Sim-to-Real Logic
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 论述具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人策略时，严禁将其等同于静态图像识别。必须突出**闭环反馈（Closed-loop feedback）**、**分布外状态累积偏移（Covariate shift in sequential decision-making）**、**接触动力学不确定性（Contact-rich dynamics）**以及**机载实时推理延迟约束（Onboard real-time latency）**。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Unlike static perception where errors remain isolated, closed-loop manipulation compounds small action deviations into out-of-distribution states. -> To maintain stability under contact uncertainty, our policy [Mechanism].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 把机器人控制写得像普通分类任务（The robot looks at the image and outputs the right class of movement）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: The robot sees the image from the camera and predicts the action to pick up the cup accurately.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Unlike static visual recognition where prediction errors remain isolated across samples, closed-loop robotic manipulation compounds minor trajectory deviations into unfamiliar contact states. To prevent this covariate drift during precision assembly, our visuomotor policy conditions short-horizon action chunks on real-time wrist force-torque feedback.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 鲜明对比静态视觉与闭环操作中的误差累积（covariate drift），并引出视觉-力觉多模态短视野动作块控制机制。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想在 Experiments 开篇说明：我们为什么选这几类数据集和这几类基线模型，证明我们的实验设计是全面、公平且直击痛点的。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: We use ETT, Weather, Electricity, and Traffic datasets. We compare with Autoformer, PatchTST, iTransformer, and DLinear. We use MSE and MAE as metrics, and the lookback window is 96.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L017 局限性（Limitations）的无损诚实写法：界定适用边界而非自毁贡献）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 只是把数据集名字和基线名字干巴巴列了一遍，没有说明选这些数据集和基线背后的科学验证意图。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: To evaluate robustness across diverse non-stationary regimes, we conduct experiments on seven public benchmarks spanning energy grid load (ETT, ECL), meteorological telemetry (Weather), and urban traffic flow (Traffic). Notably, Weather contains abrupt atmospheric pressure transitions that test non-stationary adaptability, whereas Traffic spans 862 synchronized sensors that challenge high-dimensional scalability. We benchmark our approach against 11 state-of-the-art methods across three paradigms: channel-independent patch Transformers (PatchTST), variate-mixing architectures (iTransformer, Crossformer), and frequency-domain forecasters (TimesNet, FEDformer). All baselines are reproduced under identical lookback windows ($L=96$) and prediction horizons ($H \in \{96, 192, 336, 720\}$) using standard MSE and MAE metrics.

focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: To solve this problem, first, the government should pass strict laws to punish bad people. Second, schools and media should educate the public and raise their awareness. Only in this way can we build a harmonious society.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L007 因果机制链 vs. 表面相关性切分（Causality vs. Correlation））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 典型的中式六级万金油套话（pass strict laws, raise awareness, Only in this way can we...），放之四海而皆空，考官已产生严重审美疲劳。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Curbing the proliferation of fabricated academic data requires coordinated reforms across both peer-review protocols and institutional promotion criteria. First, journal editorial boards should mandate that empirical submissions include executable code containers and raw sensor logs, enabling automated reproducibility checks before external review. Concurrently, university tenure committees must shift evaluation weight from raw publication counts toward verified open-source contributions and replication studies. Aligning technical verification with career incentives removes the underlying pressure to fabricate incremental results.
